caption: Our test estimate, Test Kitchen Remodel, with three manual line items and a total of $6,840. We did not send it. The company name in the header is hidden.
The module switches on Basic: projects, to-dos, estimates, invoices and payments, but no daily log or scheduling module. A to-do stood in for the planning step. The company name is hidden.
The Basic annual trial: $588 a year, nothing charged today and the trial ending on 19 December 2026. Subscription ID and card digits are hidden.
Cancelling starts with a reason screen with four choices. Next came an offer to extend the trial by 14 days, which we declined, and a feedback box that wants at least 45 characters.
The last of five cancellation screens offers a 1:1 setup session before Confirm & Cancel. A seven question survey followed, and Paddle then confirmed by email that the trial runs until 19 December.
